Hi — I'm the plant manager at Apex Stamping & Plating Co. in Beaumont, TX. We just got a heads-up from our legal team that TCEQ may conduct a surprise inspection within the next 90 days, and frankly I'm worried we have some serious gaps after our last citation in 2022.

I've put together a facility profile file called `facility_profile.json` in the workspace that captures our operations, current permits, chemicals on-site, waste generation, and what we found during our last internal audit.

Can you produce a comprehensive compliance assessment report saved as `compliance_assessment.json`? It should tell me:
1. How we're actually classified under federal waste and air regulations (I want to make sure we're in the right category)
2. An honest risk score for our compliance posture across all the areas that matter, with the final number and what tier that puts us in
3. Which mandatory government reports we're required to file, with their deadlines
4. What we need to fix first, and any strategies to reduce our potential fines if violations are found

Please base everything on what's actually in the facility profile — I don't want generic advice.
